Definition: from G5092 and G2316; dear to God; Timotheus, a Christian:--Timotheus, Timothy.
BiblicalUsage: Timothy is Paul's beloved son in the faith and his fellow worker. Paul sends him to Corinth to bring the churches into remembrance of his ways, and his name stands beside Paul and Silvanus at the head of the letter to the Thessalonians.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Timothy shows what discipleship looks like across a lifetime: a young man trusted with churches, letters and hard journeys, and named by Paul as faithful in the Lord. I hold his example close, because faithfulness over years matters more than brilliance in a moment.
